name: skills
description: Skills for Claude Code: a foundation planner and the builder that executes it, an iterative loop with a stopping rule, the capture/run pair for unattended improvement work, and the bug diagnosis/fix pair used on NectarCRM, and the session handoff pair: close a session with a resumable record, finish a task and retire it, and a Bitbucket pull request reviewer that applies its verdict.

plugins.name: alicerce
plugins.description: Plans the step zero of a new project, or audits an existing one against a foundation rubric.

plugins.name: obra
plugins.description: Raises the foundation from the plan the alicerce wrote, and stops when the mould is proven.

plugins.name: ciclo
plugins.description: Iterative loop with a stated objective, a success criterion and a budget of turns.

plugins.name: pauta
plugins.description: Captures a small improvement as an item an unsupervised agent can actually run.

plugins.name: turno
plugins.description: Runs the ready items overnight on a single branch, unattended, and leaves a report for the morning.

plugins.name: fechar-sessao
plugins.description: Leaves a resumable record of where the session stopped, in the task's own pending doc.

plugins.name: finalizar-tarefa
plugins.description: Points out what is still open, asks, and retires the task's pending doc.

plugins.name: bug-diagnostico
plugins.description: Bug investigation assistant for NectarCRM (Java Struts + AngularJS).

plugins.name: bug-guardrail
plugins.description: Process gate for fixing bugs with AI on NectarCRM (Java Struts + AngularJS).

plugins.name: revisar-pr-bitbucket
plugins.description: Reviews Bitbucket PRs for fix, breakage and security holes, then comments + requests changes or approves (never merges).
